code: set.seed(22) n <- 120 arm <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.5) alpha_true <- -1 beta_true <- 2 pi_true <- plogis(alpha_true + beta_true * arm) z <- rbinom(n, 1, pi_true)  c(true_probability_control = plogis(alpha_true),   true_probability_vaccine = plogis(alpha_true + beta_true),   realised_state1 = sum(z)) #> true_probability_control true_probability_vaccine          realised_state1  #>                0.2689414                0.7310586               58.0000000 G <- seq(-0.8, 0.8, by = 0.05) MS <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.9, 1.5) candidates <- expand.grid(g = G, ms = MS) candidates$A0 <- 400 candidates$C1 <- 900 candidates$C2 <- 0.35 * candidates$C1 candidates$D1 <- candidates$C1 * 10^candidates$g candidates$D2 <- 0.70 * candidates$D1  w_positive_g <- dnorm(G, 0.35, 0.15) * (G > 0) w_nonpositive_g <- dnorm(G, -0.25, 0.18) * (G <= 0) w_positive_g <- w_positive_g / sum(w_positive_g) w_nonpositive_g <- w_nonpositive_g / sum(w_nonpositive_g)  atom <- integer(n) for (i in seq_len(n)) {   gain_index <- sample(seq_along(G), 1,                        prob = if (z[i]) w_positive_g else w_nonpositive_g)   decay_index <- sample(seq_along(MS), 1)   atom[i] <- gain_index + (decay_index - 1L) * length(G) } times <- c(0, 1, 2.8, 3.7, 8.4, 14, 19.6) trajectory <- function(time, theta) {   andraud_trajectory(time, theta$A0, theta$C1, theta$C2,                      theta$D1, theta$D2, theta$ms) }  obs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {   mu <- trajectory(times, candidates[atom[i], ])   data.frame(id = i, time = times,              value = 10^(log10(mu) + rnorm(length(times), 0, 0.12))) }))
